caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition bordered with a red scalloped edge and swirling red leaf and branch motifs. Inside the border, there are twelve smaller rectangular and square panels arranged in a grid, surrounding a central circular wreath design. The central design features a red basket at the bottom of a floral wreath composed of red, pink, blue, and yellow flowers with green leaves, with a pair of red scissors positioned above the basket. Each surrounding panel displays brightly colored objects, primarily baskets or vases filled with multicolored flowers in red, blue, yellow, and orange, as well as birds (one yellow bird in a floral wreath, another flying with flowers), and patriotic elements like the American flag held by a brown eagle. Some panels include additional decorative items such as fruit, ribbons, or books. All the depicted objects are drawn with fine lines and filled with solid colors, creating a unified appearance throughout the artwork. The background is an off-white color, and the artist’s name, “Lillian Causey,” is written in black text in the bottom right corner.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
